Plant Health and Growth Stage: Your banana plant is in the Seedling Stage (1 month old). Environmental Conditions: Aim for a temperature of 28-32 C (82-90 F) and high humidity (80-90 ). Since weather data for Pune is unavailable, monitor local conditions closely. Ensure the plant receives 6-8 hours of direct sunlight daily. Fertilizer: Use BioStart at 20 mL plant, applying it as a soil drench every 7-10 days to promote strong root development. You can also use vermicompost as an organic option, applying a handful around the base of the plant every two weeks. Physiological Needs: Focus on root development. Ensure proper drainage to prevent root rot. Monitor leaf color and growth rate as indicators of plant health. Weather Impact: Watering: Without weather data, it s difficult to give a precise watering schedule. Check the soil moisture daily. Water when the top inch of soil feels dry. Ensure good drainage. Temperature and Humidity: If temperatures are high, consider misting the plant regularly to maintain humidity. If temperatures are too high, provide shade during the hottest part of the day. Disease and Pest Management: Disease: You ve identified Panama disease. Unfortunately, Panama disease is a serious fungal disease that can be difficult to control. Remove and destroy the infected plant material immediately to prevent spread. Improve soil drainage and aeration. Pest Management: Since the plant is in the seedling stage, pests can be particularly damaging. Regularly inspect the plant for any signs of pests.
